hypotheses.statement: Increasing swirl intensity analog s consistently improves stability.
hypotheses.note: Sparse 5-D comparisons challenge a globally monotonic swirl-stability relationship. Other design coordinates also vary, so this is not a controlled one-factor causal falsification; use the fixed-family swirl sweep for follow-up.

hypotheses.statement: Unstable conditions form a single connected region in the explored domain.
hypotheses.note: The campaign did not isolate a disconnected region.

discoveries.note: A verified stable/unstable partition exists under the Rayleigh-from-mixing criterion.
